author: Budy6979
quote: Disappointed there are no other options for romance for Aloy. I feel like the series thus far has been trying to illustrate how Aloy is her own person apart from Elizabet, but making her also lesbian takes away from that notion. I also find it frustrating that they decided to introduce the romance subplot for Aloy in a DLC with a brand new character, of all things. If they wanted to broach romance for Aloy, it would have made more sense to do so in the next game, where the player has multiple character options or can choose to avoid romance altogether.
